manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it. A released ball falls right alongside.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball side by side. Vectors display velocity and acceleration in real time.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Pause or drag the timeline to inspect the top.
